item.summary: The Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (DoSJE) under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, will sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Directorate General Defence Estates (DGDE), Ministry of Defence, in the National Capital here on November 16 Monday.
item.title: MoU Between DoSJE and DGDE to Extend Senior Citizen Welfare Schemes to Cantonment Boards Across the Country
